assets.title: Public Pedestal Drinking Station
assets.description: Original fixed outdoor pedestal drinking station with a real open lateral basin, sloping inner floor and recessed drain floor, side arm and diagonal brace, protected fixed bubbler, upper open-front cup alcove, solid ledge and fixed downward outlet. Static editable components only. Actual original open mug and paving node are used separately for bounded geometric support and clearance checks. No water flow, pressure, plumbing, drinking or hygiene safety, accessibility, frost or load certification; no operating or continuous insertion capability.
